title: Dressed chibi bases: first fit
question: Does the simpler body work for Mio and Eric?

options.label: v16-mio: simpler body with source layers
options.note: One hip ring removed from v15; head and eyes unchanged. Original layers leave skin protruding through shoulders and the back. The fitted trial covers more skin but distorts hems and shoes; it is not ready for the game.

options.label: v16-eric: simpler body with source layers
options.note: One hip ring removed from v15; head and eyes unchanged. Original layers leave skin protruding through shoulders. The fitted trial covers more skin but distorts hems and shoes; it is not ready for the game.
